issueTypes.name: Bug report
issueTypes.description: Report a reproducible defect in TEVM.

issueTypes.name: Feature request
issueTypes.description: Propose an actionable, testable TEVM capability.

issueTypes.name: Documentation issue
issueTypes.description: Fix incorrect, missing, or confusing TEVM documentation.

issueTypes.name: EVM conformance failure
issueTypes.description: Report a GST, execution-spec, Hive, or trace parity failure.

issueTypes.name: Maintenance task
issueTypes.description: Propose dependency, tooling, CI, refactor, or repository maintenance.

plugin.name: tevm-factory
plugin.title: TEVM coding factory
plugin.summary: Deterministic checks, PR-history-derived agentic review, bounded repair recipes, and contributor-ready candidate gates for TEVM.

entries.label: //factory:check
entries.title: Factory contract
entries.summary: Validate issue policy, queue contracts, declarations, repository identity, generated contributor data, and source integrity.

entries.label: //factory:preflight
entries.title: Local preflight
entries.summary: Check the pinned toolchain and exact local Flows and Zevm sibling revisions before running agent lanes.

entries.label: //:mechanicalPrePush
entries.title: Mechanical pre-push
entries.summary: Run repository lint, typecheck, and test gates without spending an agent seat.

entries.label: //:ci
entries.title: Complete CI
entries.summary: Build, cover, test, lint, document, validate Rust, and enforce factory and changeset policy across the monorepo.

entries.label: //factory:sourceIntegrity
entries.title: Source integrity
entries.summary: Reject merge markers, malformed generated output, and orphaned gitlinks.

entries.label: //factory:repositoryMetadataLint
entries.title: Repository metadata
entries.summary: Keep package and release-workflow provenance on the canonical evmts/tevm repository.

entries.label: //:agentLints
entries.title: All agentic lints
entries.summary: Review the applied diff for public API, tests, docs, changesets, wire contracts, regression proof, and scope coherence.

entries.label: //:rpcContractLint
entries.title: JSON-RPC wire contract
entries.summary: Check exact request, result, serialization, dispatch, error, and public-client surfaces for changed RPC code.

entries.label: //:regressionProofLint
entries.title: Regression proof
entries.summary: Judge whether a fix proves the failing public boundary, negative branches, state isolation, and equivalent inputs.

entries.label: //:scopeCoherenceLint
entries.title: Scope coherence
entries.summary: Distinguish coherent mechanical fan-out from unrelated or speculative change churn.

entries.label: //:prReview
entries.title: Pull-request review
entries.summary: Run the repository review checklist locally over the current diff.

entries.label: //factory:repositoryMetadataWrite
entries.title: Synchronize repository metadata
entries.summary: Apply the bounded mechanical repository-identity repair across manifests and release workflows.

entries.label: //workflows/fix-ci:fixCi
entries.title: Repair CI
entries.summary: Use the failing CI graph and current diff to prepare a locally gated repair candidate.

entries.label: //workflows/upgrade-viem:upgradeViem
entries.title: Upgrade Viem
entries.summary: Synchronize Viem versions, peer ranges, lockfile, snapshots, and a changeset in one bounded candidate.

entries.label: //:preCommit
entries.title: Pre-commit gate
entries.summary: Run root formatting, changeset status, and the factory contract before creating a commit.

entries.label: //:prePush
entries.title: Pre-push gate
entries.summary: Combine deterministic candidate checks with every PR-history-derived agentic lint.

guidedWorkflows.title: Triage an issue
guidedWorkflows.summary: Normalize an existing issue and write a reviewable queue plan without GitHub write access.
guidedWorkflows.label: //workflows/issue-triage:triageIssue

guidedWorkflows.title: Implement an approved issue
guidedWorkflows.summary: Prepare a gated local candidate after a maintainer has applied factory:ready.
guidedWorkflows.label: //workflows/issue-to-pr:implementIssue

guidedWorkflows.title: Add a JSON-RPC method
guidedWorkflows.summary: Generate the complete typed, serialized, dispatched, tested, documented, and exported RPC surface.
guidedWorkflows.label: //workflows/add-jsonrpc-method:addJsonrpcMethod

guidedWorkflows.title: Repair an RPC regression
guidedWorkflows.summary: Reproduce the public wire failure first, then repair the full contract and its negative branches.
guidedWorkflows.label: //workflows/repair-rpc-regression:repairRpcRegression
guidedWorkflows.command: pnpm factory:rpc-repair -- --input method=eth_getStorageAt --input 'report=<actual and expected wire values>'

guidedWorkflows.title: Synchronize a public surface
guidedWorkflows.summary: Fan an existing symbol through recursive barrels, the TEVM facade, docs, and a changeset.
guidedWorkflows.label: //workflows/sync-public-surface:syncPublicSurface

guidedWorkflows.title: Raise package coverage
guidedWorkflows.summary: Add real regression tests around the least-covered paths and raise the proven package threshold.
guidedWorkflows.label: //workflows/raise-coverage:raiseCoverage

guidedWorkflows.title: Triage conformance drift
guidedWorkflows.summary: Isolate a GST or execution-spec fixture, compare traces, and prepare a bounded EVM repair.
guidedWorkflows.label: //workflows/conformance-triage:conformanceTriage

commands.clone:
git clone https://github.com/<your-handle>/tevm.git
cd tevm
corepack enable
pnpm factory:bootstrap
